description: Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) and Data Safe security telemetry covering AVDF audit events, DB Firewall policy events, AVDF admin/system audit, AVDF alerts, Data Safe audit trail, and Data Safe risk findings. Typical forwarding: AVDF SIEM/REST export or collector JSON relay; Data Safe via OCI Audit/Logging API pull. Source-shape acquisition is blocked; no relay envelope selected and no validated parser exists yet. Operator action required: provide fixture events before this source can be promoted.
